purpose: Closed-eye keyframes; only feathered eye regions are sampled at runtime

prompts.calm: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a precise CLOSED-EYES animation keyframe of the supplied Kora image. This is the edit target and MUST retain exact canvas dimensions, head position, framing, proportions, fur, colors, lighting, facial outline, ears, headband, nose, mouth expression, clothing, hands, legs and feet. Change ONLY the tiny areas occupied by the two eyes: close BOTH eyes fully with natural furry eyelids and a subtle curved dark eyelid seam, following each existing eye's angle and location. No visible eyeballs or highlights when closed, no eyelashes, no eyebrows, no new expression. Eyes should look mid-blink, not squeezed or smiling. Keep the surrounding fur seamlessly matching the existing face. Everything outside the two eyes must remain unchanged and aligned to the source so this can be a blinking animation frame. Keep the exact transparent background and same full-body square framing.
